model_detail: Claude Opus 5, operated through Claude Cowork with browser and shell tooling; geometry computed with shapely/pyproj in EPSG:4548. The GeoJSON layers, figures, drawings and 3D tour data were produced by deterministic parameterised scripts run in that environment; the package carries their outputs (geometry/*.geojson, assets/figures/*.png, drawings/*.pdf, visual/assets/gauge-tour-data.js) and the hand-written renderer visual/assets/gauge-tour.js, not the generator scripts themselves.
